raj_release: Scheduling schema migration 'add_user_profile_state' for prod tonight 2025-06-10 23:00 UTC. Runbook below. @sre-oncall @mike_db please ack.
DeployBot: Migration job created (id mig-4621), scheduled for 2025-06-10T23:00:00Z. Will attempt canary in 3 shards.
emma_eng: Ack. Staging smoke passed; no schema drift. Logs: https://ci/1234
mike_db: Ack. Locking strategy: per-tenant advisory locks, 60s window, parallelism 4. Backfill runs with batch_size=1000. I'll be watching pg_stat_activity.
sre-oncall: Ack. I'll be online for the window and will watch infra alerts. Pager rotations set.
raj_release: Quick runbook (minimal):
```
- freeze writes to profile_events for 2m via feature-flag
- run migration DDL (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN)
- run backfill job with safe_batch=1000
- verify sample user profiles (SELECT id, state FROM user_profiles WHERE id IN (...))
- run VACUUM ANALYZE on affected table
- unfreeze writes
```
carla_prodeng: Question: if backfill spike > 80% CPU, do we abort? What's abort criteria?
mike_db: Abort if p99 latency > 500ms for >2m or CPU > 90% for >3m. If abort, stop backfill, drop partial rows, run rollback DDL (ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN) only if partial DDL recorded.
raj_release: Noted. We'll pin service-mesh version v2.3.1 for the window to avoid sidecar restarts. Release notes updated.
stacey_docs: Added postmortem template and rollback steps to release doc: https://docs/release/add_user_profile_state
DeployBot: Preflight checks: schema lint OK, migration tests OK, blocked dependencies: none. Canary job scheduled at 22:30 UTC for 3 shards.
emma_eng: I'll kick canary at 22:30 and report within 10 mins.
raj_release: If canary green, proceed at 23:00. If canary fails, rollback plan is: abort backfill, revert feature flag, mark migration stalled, re-schedule. Keep thread updated.
sre-oncall: Oncall contact: @sre-oncall (mobile on). I also enabled temporary scale-up policy: +2 read replicas if DB CPU >75%.
mike_db: I'll have a script ready:
```
./ops/run_backfill.sh --migration mig-4621 --batch 1000 --parallel 4
```
DeployBot: Reminder 22:20 UTC - Runbook review in 10m. :bell: 
raj_release: Thanks all. Tag me if you see anything odd during canary.
